cleavage_agent.evidence: To digest the proteins 1 µL endoproteinase Lys-C (LysC) (1 M in ddH2O) was added to each sample and incubated for 2.5 h at RT under continuous shaking (450 rpm) and exclusion of light.

Afterwards 600 µL, tetraethylammonium bromide (TEAB) (50 mM in ddH2O) and 1.5 µL Trypsin (0.5 µg/µL in ddH2O) were added and the samples were incubated over night at 37 °C under continuous shaking (450 rpm).

enrichment_method.evidence: For enrichment the protein solution was added to 50 µL pre-washed avidin-agarose beads suspension (1.1 mg/mL in glycerol, washed 3 times with 1 mL PBS + 0.4% SDS) and incubated for 1 h under continuous gentle mixing.
